item.description: Record-setting rain, unprecedented flooding and near-hurricane force winds wreaked havoc on holiday plans from coast to coast and leaving nearly a million people dealing with power outages. Meanwhile, airports are scrambling to get back on track after thousands of delayed flights and cancellations. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports and Weekend TODAY meteorologist Angie Lassman tracks the forecast.

media:content.media:title: Severe Weather Wreaks Havoc on Thanksgiving Plans Across US

item.description: For the first time in its 100-year history, the world-famous Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. The unprecedented decision by Macy’s and New York City was made after forecasters warned of potentially dangerous storm conditions. NBC’s Erin McLaughlin reports for TODAY.
